column3: “Restore from captivity” renders turning back captivity.
“Awful” renders great in the exclamation of woe.
“Their necks” and “their bonds” replace “your neck” and “your bonds.”
The last clause is passive instead of “I will give ... as spoil.”
“Their” replaces the singular possessive referring to Jacob.
“Dare on his own” replaces the image of pledging his heart.
“Days to come” renders the end of days.
